settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["color"], ["red"]) == ["fast", "3", "red"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var others: List[str] = []
  var vals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = v.copy()
    else if k == "level"
      level = v.copy()
    else
      var found = False
      for j in range(0, others.len())
        if others[j] == k
          vals[j] = v.copy()
          found = True
          break
      if not found
        others.append(k.copy())
        vals.append(v.copy())
  var result: List[str] = [mode, level]
  for v in vals
    result.append(v.copy())
  result
